items.title: Sanjay Raut publicly apologizes after SC issues criminal-contempt show-cause notice
items.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut — petitioner no. 6 in the INDIA-bloc SIR writ — publicly apologized Friday evening after the SC bench (CJI Surya Kant + Justice Joymalya Bagchi) issued show-cause notices to him and journalist Nikhil Wagle in criminal-contempt proceedings on SCBA's plea (AG R Venkataramani's consent). Speaking to reporters, Raut said neither he nor his party intended to disrespect the judiciary: 'If the Supreme Court feels I have made any inappropriate remarks against it, there is nothing wrong in apologizing to the institution that protects the Indian Constitution,' adding he is ready to formally apologize. He also used the moment to reiterate his demand that the judiciary address the alleged deletion of 13 crore voters and to complain that the Sena name/symbol dispute has dragged on 4.5 years across four CJIs. Follows the alerted 16:06Z show-cause arc (sc-raut-wagle-showcause-oct16). Published 2026-10-16T17:55:12Z; missed by the 18:24Z/19:14Z/19:46Z runs. Covering outlets: India Bytes (this statement); LiveLaw independently reported Raut expressed regret in an earlier ANI interview (pre-notice). Confidence single-sourced.
